# gitmoap_group_ai_org_sessions (Data Source)

The organization's sessions, newest first. Narrow it to one agent, one state, one squad — the squad each session's agent was in when it started — or one ritual run's sessions. A session that read from a group or repository you cannot read is left out.

The token needs `ai_org:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_ai_org_sessions" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

### Optional

- `agent_id` (String) Only this agent's sessions
- `ritual_run_id` (String) Only the sessions taking part in this ritual run
- `squad` (String) Only the sessions whose agent was in this squad when they started
- `state` (String) Only sessions in this state

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `agent_id` (String)
- `branch` (String)
- `carried_workspace` (String) Which of an ended session's workspace objects the platform copied into the session continuing
it, for its workspace to start from: the newer of its last checkpoint and its last out-bundle.
- `continuation_id` (String)
- `continues_session_id` (String)
- `cost_micros` (Number) Settled spend, fee included, in micro-dollars.
- `created_at` (String)
- `ended_at` (String)
- `instruction` (String)
- `model_id` (String)
- `org_id` (String)
- `outcome` (String)
- `pinned_memory` (Attributes) The versions of the memory pages a session pinned when it started — what its agent was told,
whatever the pages say now. A page absent here was empty, or not the agent's to read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--pinned_memory))
- `repository_id` (String)
- `revision_number` (Number) The revision it pinned at start; absent only for a platform session started before any
revision was published.
- `ritual_run_id` (String) A ritual run's id: one occurrence of one of an AI organization's rituals.
- `root_group_id` (String)
- `session_id` (String)
- `squad_key` (String)
- `started_at` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `subject` (Attributes) What a session was started on, as an address such as `acme/api#412`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--subject))
- `summary` (String) The agent's own account of the session.
- `trigger_kind` (String) What started a session.
- `turns` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--items--pinned_memory"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.pinned_memory`

Read-Only:

- `agent` (Number) The agent's own page.
- `conventions` (Number) The organization's conventions.
- `squad` (Number) Its squad's page.


<a id="nestedatt--items--subject"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.subject`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The address acted on — `acme/api#412`, `acme/api!87` — when the session has one.
- `started_by` (String) The person or account whose action started the session, when one did.
